fields.System.Title: RPL-401 — Read demand from released and pending waves
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a replenishment planner, I want to know what upcoming waves will consume, so that
refills happen before the shortage rather than after it.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given released and planned waves, then total demand per product per pick location can
  • be calculated.
  • - Given the calculation, then it reads wave contents through an outbound service call,
  • not by querying outbound tables directly.
  • - Given a wave is cancelled, then its demand is removed from the calculation.
  • - Given a configurable look-ahead window, then only waves within it are counted.
  • - Given the demand view, then it is refreshed frequently enough to act on before the
  • wave releases.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment, outbound |
| Tables | demand view, wave, order_line |
| Risks | Reaching into another module's tables ([doc 04 §6](../../../docs/04-modules.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
